Definition: from G2095 and a derivative of G5483; well favored, i.e. (by implication) grateful:--thankful.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, eucháristos means well favored, that is grateful. It occurs just once, in Colossians.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe eucháristos is best left as Scripture leaves it: well favored, that is grateful.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
